title: $130M+ to One Founder, Feds Allege: Where $600M Went

lines.say: More than a hundred thirty million dollars went to one founder's accounts, prosecutors allege, from a forex firm that raised six hundred million.
lines.show: More than $130 million went to one founder's accounts, prosecutors allege, from a forex firm that raised $600 million.

scene.label: TO ONE FOUNDER'S ACCOUNTS|PER THE COMPLAINT

lines.say: At least about two hundred million, the complaint says, paid earlier investors with newer investors' money.
